dog_ml.label: FG Underdog ML Last Season Only
dog_ml.text: The signals pick the underdog at +100 to +200 because the market overrates last season, with no line move toward it against the tickets (a line move goes to FG Underdog ML Line Move).

dog_ml_rlm.label: FG Underdog ML Line Move
dog_ml_rlm.text: The signals pick the underdog, its moneyline is +100 to +200, and the line moved toward it against the tickets (reverse line movement).

fav_ml.label: FG Favorite ML Lead 1
fav_ml.text: The signals pick the favorite by a lead under 2 points and its moneyline is -200 to -100 (a lead of 2+ goes to FG Favorite ML Lead 2+).

fav_ml_2.label: FG Favorite ML Lead 2+
fav_ml_2.text: The signals favor the favorite by 2+ points and its moneyline is -200 to -100.

dog_spread.label: FG Underdog Spread Last Season Only
dog_spread.text: The signals pick the underdog because the market overrates last season, with no line move toward it against the tickets (a line move goes to FG Underdog Spread Line Move).

dog_spread_rlm.label: FG Underdog Spread Line Move
dog_spread_rlm.text: The signals pick the underdog and the line moved toward it against the tickets (reverse line movement).

strong_spread.label: FG Strong Spread Lead 5
strong_spread.text: Side signals lead by 5 points but under 6 (6+ goes to FG Strong Spread Lead 6+).

strong_spread_6.label: FG Strong Spread Lead 6+
strong_spread_6.text: The side signals lead by 6+ points.

one_sided.label: FG Two-Signal Total
one_sided.text: At least two of money vs tickets, PRO systems and sharp action sit on one side of the total, and none of them on the other.

versions.version: Two of money vs tickets, PRO, sharp action

one_sided_1.label: FG One-Signal Total
one_sided_1.text: Exactly one signal: money vs tickets or PRO systems on one side of the total, neither on the other, and the game does not fit FG Two-Signal Total.

versions.version: Exactly one signal: money vs tickets or PRO, and the Two-Signal Total does not fit
